senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. Del. Proleg., p. 98, sq.) [to conquer,] to break ground, clear.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Menahot 9:3">Tosef. Men. IX, 3</cite> <he>נָרָהּ שנה ראשונה ושנייה חורשה וכ׳</he> he breaks the field the first year, the second year he ploughs it &c.; <cite ref="Menachot 85a">Men. 85ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 9:1">Arakh. IX, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Arakhin 29b:4">29ᵇ</cite>) <he>נָרָהּ</he> if he broke it (without planting).

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 9:7">Tosef. B. Mets. IX, 7</cite> <he>לא יהא נָר … אלא נָאר וכ׳</he> (Var. <cite ref="N01255"><he>נָר</he></cite>) he must not plough it over entirely one year and plant the next, but plough one half &c.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 9:8">Ib. 8</cite> <he>והיה נָרָהּ וכ׳</he> and he ploughed all of it one year &c.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 9:26">Ib. 26</cite> <cite ref="N00034"><he>נאר</he></cite> (Var. <cite ref="N00664"><he>נָיֵיר</he></cite>, <cite ref="N01255"><he>נָר</he></cite>); a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="N00783"><he>נִיר</he></cite>; f. <he>נִירָה</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 9:29">Ib. 29</cite> <he>מניחה לפניו נ׳</he> when he surrenders the field to him cleared, opp. <cite ref="U01372"><he>שֶׁלֶף</he></cite>.—[<cite ref="Menachot 85b:6">Men. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>ניר חציה</he>, Ms. M. <cite ref="N01255"><he>נָר</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to plough over repeatedly. Part. pass. מְנוֹנָר (= מְנוּרְנָר; cmp. מְטוֹטֶלֶת a. מְטוּלְטֶלֶת); f. מְנוֹנֶרֶת, pl. מְנוֹנָרוֹת.
units: Men. 85ᵃ שדות … והמ׳ לכך (Ms. M. הנונרות לבד, corr. acc. or הנִינָּרוֹת Nif.) fields … repeatedly ploughed over for that purpose; Tosef. ib. IX, 3 הגינירות, Var. הניטרות, read הנִינָּרוֹת or הנִינּוֹרוֹת).

senses.gloss: (cmp. נִידּוֹן fr. דִּין) to be broken, v. supra.
